scope: Cumulative native World Prepared admission memory; actual pre-cutover images versus current images, one unchanged World implementation. This does not qualify execution/checkpoint timing.

measurement.api: World.Prepared.init with World.Workspace allocator; peak_payload and Prepared.storageBytes; ReleaseSafe Zig 0.16.0 native
measurement.timing: unqualified: concurrent build active; samples omitted

acceptance: Open: six admission-memory regressions, ReAct execution-memory growth, and four reproducible admission-timing regressions require correction or explicit owner acceptance. Execution/checkpoint timing is not qualified here.

admissionTiming.method: Independent alternating processes; three warmup batches and nine measured batches of 64 cold preparations. Three windows, plus two confirmation windows for suspected >5% slowdown.
admissionTiming.environmentCaveat: Shared workstation with background processes; no uncontended-host claim. No execution or checkpoint timing claim.
